name: Marigold the Trader
conversations: Welcome, welcome! Marigold's Marvellous Wares! Today's marvels: a bucket, a slightly bent spoon, and a jar of air from Leafwind.
Don't laugh. That's premium air. Very fresh. Well, it was.
I've traded on every island in the sky. Barkton pays in arguments, Seedhaven pays in muffins.
Rootholm doesn't pay at all, but they give you a very firm handshake. Very firm. I still can't feel two fingers.
My granny swore traders once carried gifts to the Great Tree, every spring. Not for coin. Just because.
Nobody does that any more. Mind you, nobody tells me anything. I just sell spoons.
Shop's not open yet, love. I'm waiting on a delivery of hats. Or possibly cats. The letter was smudged.
Either way, come back later. It'll be exciting, or furry.
